Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.939371, -75.080331 (Approximated from route)
Reported Spill Volume: 5 gallon
Report Description
CALLER STATED A MOTOR VEHICLE STRUCK A POLE HOLDING A TRANSFORMER. THIS RESULTED IN THE TRANSFORMER COMING DOWN AND A SPILL OF NON PCB TRANSFORMER OIL. CALLER STATED THE SPILL REACHED A STORM DRAIN DUE TO A SEWAGE LINE FROM A GAS STATION THAT IS BACKED UP. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: CALLER STATED THE SEWAGE LINE FROM THE GAS STATION IS BACKED UP AND IS LEAKING BIO-HAZARD FLUIDS OUT OF THE BLACKTOP RIGHT ALONG THE ROAD. CALLER STATED THOSE FLUIDS ARE GOING UPSTREAM OF THE OIL IMPACT OF THE GROUND SO THE BIO-HAZARD FLUIDS ARE PICKING UP THE OIL AND HAVE PUT THE SPILLED TRANSFORMER OIL INTO THE STORM DRAIN AS EVERYTHING FLOWS TOWARD THE STORM DRAIN. CALLER STATED THE SPILL FROM THE TRANSFORMER WOULD HAVE WENT ONTO THE BLACKTOP/CONCRETE BUT SINCE THE SEWAGE LINE IS BACKED UP THE SPILL HAS REACHED THE STORM DRAIN.

Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTED THAT A WRECKER WAS ATTEMPTING TO TOW A VEHICLE THAT WAS TOO LARGE FOR IT TO HAUL AND WAS GOING UP A 9% GRADE HILL WHEN IT LOST CONTROL AND CAME DOWN THE HILL, STRIKING AND KNOCKING OVER A UTILITY POLE. POWER LINES CAME DOWN AND A TRANSFORMER DISCHARGED AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF MINERAL OIL. IT IS UNKNOWN IF THE MINERAL OIL CONTAINED PCB. IT IS UNKNOWN IF ANY WATERWAYS WERE IMPACTED, BUT THERE IS POTENTIAL FOR RAIN RUNOFF TO HAVE WASHED OIL INTO A NEARBY CREEK AND THE CALLER IS ALSO CONCERNED ABOUT THE WATER TABLE UNDER THE SOIL. CALLER STATED THAT THERE IS LOCALIZED DAMAGE CAUSED BY THE INCIDENT AND ESTIMATED THAT $80,000 IN DAMAGES HAD OCCURRED.

Report DescriptionCNUE/NNEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION REPORT STATES I WAS SURFING THIS MORNING AT JORDAN RIVER. I GOT IN THE WATER JUST AFTER 9AM AND AROUND 9:30 I STARTED TO SMELL DIESEL/WEATHER GASOLINE. AROUND 9:55 I SAW A SHEEN IN THE BAY JUST WEST OF THE RIVER MOUTH AND IMMEDIATELY GOT OUT OF THE WATER. I WALKED OVER TO THE BRIDGE AFTER GETTING CHANGED AND NOTICED A SHEEN ON THE WATER ON THE WEST SIDE OF THE RIVER. IT SEEMED TO GO OUT TO THE LOG BOOM WHERE AN ARTICULATED LOADER AND TWO SMALL BOATS WERE MOVING LOADING LOGS. THE LOADER WAS GOING IN AND OUT OF THE WATER ON THE BOAT LAUNCH / BANK.

Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTED THAT THE SRP INDICATED THAT A FACILITY THAT MELTS SCRAP METAL RECEIVED A LOAD OF MATERIAL THAT INCLUDED CESIUM 137. THE DATE THIS OCCURRED WAS UNKNOWN TO THE CALLER. THE LOAD WAS MELTED DOWN AND THEN DURING THE WEEK OF 8/15, A FILTER BAG SHIPMENT CONTAINING THE MATERIAL WAS SENT TO A FACILITY IN CHICAGO THAT EXTRACTS METALS FROM FURNACE DUST. THE CHICAGO FACILITY RECEIVED THE MATERIAL AND DETECTED ON 8/21 AT 1000 THAT THE SHIPMENT INCLUDED CESIUM 137 AND DID NOT ACCEPT THE SHIPMENT. THE SRP FACILITY IS READING POSITIVE FOR CESIUM 137 IN THE ATMOSPHERE AND EMPLOYEE CLOTHING. THE SRP HAS NOT YET REPORTED TO THE RP IF ANY DETECTIONS WERE TRIGGERED ON THEIR END BASED ON THE ORIGINAL INCIDENT.

Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: HHMI - JANELIA FARM RESEARCH CAMPUS
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 1300 gallons
1300 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL LEAKED FROM AN ABOVE GROUND FUEL STORAGE TANK. & GENERATOR AREA. THE LEAK WAS DISCOVERED AT 1045 AM. THE ONSITE HAZARDOUS SPILL RESPONSE TEAM BEGAN TO CONTAIN AND REMEDIATE THE SPILL. APPROXIMATELY 600 GALLONS OF FUEL DRAINED INTO A NEARBY CREEK WHICH RUNS INTO THE POTOMAC RIVER. THE SPILL RESPONSE TEAM BEGAN EMERGENCY CLEAN UP RESPONSE MEASURES AT 1055AM AT THE CREEK AREA. BOOMS AND SPILL RESPONSE MATERIALS WERE PLACED IN AND NEAR THE CREEK TO PREVENT RUN OFF OF ANY OIL FROM MOVING DOWN STREAM. THE STATE DEQ WAS PHONED AT 11AM ABOUT THE SPILL IN ACCORDANCE WITH REGULATORY GUIDELINES FOR SPILL RESPONSE.

THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE ANOMALY WAS IN THE MAIN PASS AREA OFF THE LOUISIANA COAST, WAS GENERALLY THIN AND LINEAR, ORIENTED NW-SE WITH SLIGHT WIDENING TO THE NW. THE ANOMALY HAD STRONG CONTRAST WITH WELL DEFINED EDGES AND WAS DISTINGUISHABLE FROM NATURAL PHENOMENA AND SEEPS. THE ANOMALY MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 4 NM LONG, .2 NM AT ITS WIDEST. WINDS WERE FROM SE AT 10 KN, ALIGNING WITH THE ORIENTATION OF THE ANOMALY SPREADING TO THE NW. Skytruth Analysis

INDIVIDUAL IS REPORTING THAT SHE WAS STATIONED AS AN OBSERVER ABOARD THE F/V LADY ANN MARGARET. FOR SET NUMBERS 8-14 THE CAPTAIN HAD ATTACHED APPROXIMATELY FIVE, 500ML PLASTIC BOTTLES, RANDOMLY ALONG THE FIRST HALF OF THE MAINLINE SET. EACH BOTTLE WAS FILLED WITH FUEL AND HAD BEEN PRICKED WITH A PIN WITH THE INTENT OF HAVING THE FUEL SLOWLY LEAK OUT OF THE BOTTLE, WHILE THE GEAR WAS SOAKING. CAPTAIN HAD PLACED THE BOTTLES ON THE LINE AS A WHALE DETERRENT, FIGURING THAT THE SMELL OF THE LEAKED FUEL IN THE WATER WOULD DISCOURAGE THE WHALES FROM APPROACHING AND FEEDING FROM THE GEAR. THIS INFORMATION WAS LEARNED THROUGH A CONVERSATION WITH THE CAPTAIN. I HAD ASKED HIM ABOUT THE BOTTLES AND HE TOLD ME THE ABOVE INFORMATION ABOUT WHAT THE BOTTLES CONTAINED, AND WHY HE PLACED THEM ON THE LINE.
